chapter: Repertory band and wrap-up of day two
title: Feeling at his own funeral
summary: The YMHA band is under-rehearsed; he prefers not to attend.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: year it from three places at once, which is not very good. It's very disturbing.

He's got tapes of all this and they're pretty good, but it is under rehearsed naturally, it would be, it's a rehearsal band and the same people aren't there all the time and so it becomes pretty much sight reading, a lot of it. It has a tendency to be more rock than it should be which may be part of the times. I don't know that I could overcome that today because it's in the air. This is music of thirty years ago.
I prefer not to go because I always feel like I was being present at my own funeral. It's not a nice feeling. Harvey always says I should feel proud, but I don't; I feel like I'm dead.
It's a rehearsal band, so long as it stays there it's a rehearsal band. Somebody can use it, but don't take it out, especially promoters. I don't want to see
that. I suffered too much to give them anything. Musicians are something else; they're my friends but not the entrepreneurs.
